notes: s006 μέλλει is realized by the modal *shall* as its own aligned unit: it is an expressed finite verb, so the modal is not folded into the infinitive under rule 9.

s008 τοῖς takes the single *who* under rule 90. Rule 32's apposition clause does not reach it — that clause is limited in terms to a phrase for which the ASV writes more than one word for the pair — so the preceding οἷς does not empty this article.
s018 νεκρῶν takes the supplied determiner itself under rule 58, the substantival adjective being the nominal word and no article standing.
